title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
layout_note: A straight left-to-right spine (Perceive, Memory Stream, Retrieve, Retrieved Memories, Act) with two return loops: one arc rises from Retrieved Memories over the top through Plan and comes down into Memory Stream, a mirror arc dips under the bottom through Reflect and comes back up into Memory Stream. Perception enters from the left edge and action leaves at the right edge.
grouping: A dashed grey rectangle with a small bold title ('... Memory') encloses the memory part of the spine (the stores and the retrieval step); the perceive/act ends and the plan/reflect processes stay outside it. No colour at all: the figure is black, white and grey.
shapes_depth: Two box kinds encode kind of thing: processes (Perceive, Retrieve, Plan, Reflect, Act) are plain white rounded rectangles with thin black outlines and italic labels; data stores (Memory Stream, Retrieved Memories) are square-cornered bevelled 3-D plaques with a grey raised frame and bold upright labels, the main store larger and in a larger bold font. Thin black arrows: straight along the spine, large smooth arcs for the plan and reflect loops.
proposed_highlight: The memory stream is the visual centre: the biggest box, the heaviest type, a bevelled frame no other process has, inside the named dashed container; both feedback loops return into it.
lesson: Separate stores from operations by shape alone (bevelled square plaques with bold labels for memories, light rounded boxes with italic verbs for processes) and route the plan and reflect loops as symmetric arcs above and below the spine that both write back into the main memory.
notes: elements 'other' = the bevelled plaque boxes used for memory stores. Venue and year from the PDF first page (ACM reference footer 'UIST ’23').

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: believable agent memory, reflection and planning

core.what: A left-to-right spine Perceive -> Memory Stream -> Retrieve -> Retrieved Memories -> Act, with the memory store and retrieved set drawn as bevelled store boxes inside a dashed 'Generative Agent Memory' frame on the main flow.

relations.form: one horizontal spine of five boxes across the full width, Perceive at the left edge and Act at the right
Memory Stream (largest box, bold) and Retrieved Memories as bevelled grey 3-D boxes with Retrieve between them, all inside a dashed grey frame
two mirror-image arcs leave Retrieved Memories, one up to Plan and one down to Reflect, each curving back into Memory Stream, forming two loops above and below the spine

channels.colour: none; grey only marks the store boxes
channels.shape: bevelled 3-D box with bold label = data store, flat rounded box with italic label = process
channels.line: solid black arrows for all flow; dashed rectangle = memory subsystem boundary
channels.frame: dashed grey rectangle = the generative agent memory as one unit

quality.strengths: Shape separates stores from processes consistently (bevelled bold vs flat italic), the memory stream is the biggest element, and the plan / reflect feedback loops are symmetric arcs above and below a straight spine.
quality.weaknesses: No memory is drawn as data (no example observation, plan or reflection), so what is stored and retrieved is never shown; the retrieval scoring that defines the method is absent; the loops leave Retrieved Memories from its top and bottom edges rather than continuing a line, and Plan/Reflect sit outside the memory frame although they write into it.

insights.structure: A straight spine Perceive -> Memory Stream -> Retrieve -> Retrieved Memories -> Act, with the memory part enclosed in a dashed grey 'Generative Agent Memory' rectangle and Plan above, Reflect below outside it.
insights.data: No data shown; processes are white rounded boxes with italic labels and data stores are bevelled grey 3-D boxes with bold labels.
insights.emphasis: Memory Stream is the largest box with the heaviest bold text, and the two bevelled store boxes stand out against the flat process boxes.
insights.flow: Left-to-right along the spine, with two mirror arcs leaving Retrieved Memories, one over the top through Plan and one under the bottom through Reflect, both returning into Memory Stream.
insights.avoid: The bevelled 3-D boxes look dated; encode stores by a flat shape or fill instead.

arrangement.units: one spine with a dashed sub-group around the memory part; Plan and Reflect float outside
arrangement.shared: memory stream read and written by both loops
